sonnet.problem: The story card says God names what must never go on this altar. Card 7 then asks whether a burnt offering can go on it, so the setup gives away that the answer is False.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later. ... A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

sonnet.problem: The joke says "the Millers' junk drawer" without saying who the Millers are. A baker who doesn't know his backstory won't follow it.
sonnet.rule: Bakers may not know anything about his story. Anything from his backstory, like the drawer, the Millers, the shiny new stamper or the angel, is said in the line itself

sonnet.problem: The statement adds "at home", a setting the text doesn't give. Verses 37-38 only say not to make it for yourselves or to enjoy its fragrance.
sonnet.rule: No added settings. No setting the text doesn't give.
